posts.name: Escher
posts.cooked:
Oh god, don't throw down half a filk line and then wander off!  Now I can't stop thinking about it.

And all I can come up with is a diagonal rhyme that comes dangerously close to rhyming a word with itself...

 

When you're Team Adam

You're Team Adam all the way

From your first fissile atom

To your last gamma ray!

posts.cooked:
I had a hard time trying to decide which team I would be on. Can't we just stop all the fighting? D:

I feel quite satisfied with the answers to all my Daybreak questions, even the "We're not answering that one" answer. :) The one about Citizen Hammer's visor I barely even remember sending in, that's from a while ago! XD

What I wanna know now is who Jeysie's inside source with all that character inspiration knowledge is. :O

posts.cooked:
TakeWalker:

What I wanna know now is who Jeysie's inside source with all that character inspiration knowledge is.

I have a knack for remembering bits of interesting information I see in convos or random articles (like the Marilyn Monroe story as well); part of why I was a pretty good secretary back in the day. :3

Comrade Bubbles:

Mist Storm hype!

I didn't think it was possible to get me more excited about Tactics Argent Adept, but Christopher's description of his and Tempest's playstyles somehow managed it nonetheless.
